Momentum Engineering, Inc. Openings

ME00675 - Cloud Software Engineer 1

ME00675 - Cloud Software Engineer 1

Momentum Engineering, Inc. fosters an employee-centric culture. Our strength lies in our people. With a high percentage of employees holding advanced degrees in engineering, computer science, and related disciplines, we bring deep technical expertise to every mission. Our team includes professionals with security clearances and full-scope polygraphs, ensuring trusted, secure support for the most sensitive national security initiatives. Additionally, our workforce is equipped with industry-leading certifications, demonstrating a commitment to continuous learning and excellence. Most importantly, our exceptional employee retention rate reflects a culture of professional growth, mission focus, and dedication—ensuring long-term stability and expertise for our customers’ critical needs.

Job Summary

Seeking a Cloud Software Engineer 1 to support the development and deployment of enterprise cloud-based solutions within a mission-driven environment
This position contributes to the design, development, integration, and maintenance of scalable cloud-native applications supporting large-scale compute and data analytics platforms

Primary Responsibilities

Support the design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and maintenance of cloud-based software applications
Develop scalable and reliable software capabilities supporting enterprise compute and data analytics platforms
Participate in Agile software development activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, testing, and demonstrations
Analyze software and system requirements and translate them into functional software solutions
Develop and maintain software using modern programming languages and development practices
Support software installation, evaluation, enhancement, maintenance, troubleshooting, and problem resolution
Develop and maintain applications operating within Linux-based environments
Assist with integrating software applications with cloud services, APIs, databases, and supporting infrastructure
Support containerized application development and deployment
Participate in automated build, test, integration, and deployment activities
Troubleshoot software, integration, and deployment issues across development and cloud environments
Develop and maintain technical documentation associated with software development and deployment activities
Collaborate with software engineers, cloud engineers, systems engineers, test engineers, and other technical team members
Apply secure software development and DevOps practices throughout the development lifecycle
Support continuous improvement of software development, automation, and deployment processes

Required Qualifications

Must have active Top Secret/SCI clearance with NSA Full Scope Polygraph
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline and zero (0) years of experience in software development, cloud engineering, or a related technical field; or
A minimum of two (2) years of experience in software development, cloud engineering, or a related technical field in lieu of a degree
Qualifying experience must include one or more of the following:
Requirements analysis
Software development
Software installation
Software evaluation
Software enhancement
Software maintenance
Problem diagnosis and resolution
Degrees in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Systems, Engineering, or similar technical disciplines will be considered
Experience with one or more programming languages such as:
Java
Python
C++
Experience working within Linux-based operating systems

Desired Qualifications

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker
Experience with container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes
Experience with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) tools and DevOps practices
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible
Experience supporting cloud-native or distributed applications
Familiarity with automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and configuration-management practices
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and teamwork skills

Exempt hourly position.  11 paid holidays, minimum of 3 weeks PTO, company sponsored group medical plan, company paid dental, vision, life insurance, and STD/LTD plans.  Salary is dependent upon the candidate’s experience and qualifications.

The pay range for this role is:

105,000 - 140,000 USD per year (NBP)
